from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class CompanyCashRecord(BaseModel):
    """Extracted cash balance information from a single company's filing."""
    company_name: str | None = Field(description="The name of the company reporting the financials")
    metric_label: str | None = Field(description="The line item label for the cash figure as written (e.g. 'Cash', 'Cash and cash equivalents')")
    amount: float | None = Field(description="The raw numeric value reported for the metric")
    unit_scale: str | None = Field(description="The scale unit applied to the amount (e.g. 'dollars', 'thousands', 'millions')")
    period_date: str | None = Field(description="The date as of which this financial figure is reported")
    currency: str | None = Field(description="The currency of the reported amount (e.g. 'USD')")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    cash_records: list[CompanyCashRecord]
